title: 第十三章陈林的实力第十四章报仇
content_zh:
第十三章陈林的实力求点击，推荐！
陈林在退出修炼状态后，感觉到了灵魂空间外一阵吵闹，好像是有人……不是有亡灵在战斗！陈林心想可能是自己修炼时候有其它的亡灵来捣乱！
“哼！不论是谁，来找麻烦的都必须要付出沉痛的代价！”陈林被打扰很生气，正好想着找些亡灵试试身手！
这次修炼陈林得到的好绝对是巨大的，现在陈林神魂决已经达到了凡魂阶大成的水平了！而且陈林在灵魂之力发生了很大的变化，现在自己的精神力不但能够外放探索事物，而且自己还能利用自己的灵魂之力创建一个气场，在这个气场里陈林感觉自己就是这里的神，自己能够利用天地间的能量来压制敌人！
陈林不知道自己现在这种气场，就是亡灵生物在晋级高级亡灵才能够领悟的能力！这种能力被称作为伪领域，为以后晋级成为圣阶打好基础的能力！这种能力很强大，既能利用天地间的力量来压制敌人，也可以来增强自己，所以晋级高级亡灵后，亡灵的实力都会有一个很大的飞跃！
在高级以前一个六阶巅峰的亡灵最多也就能对战几个六阶中级的亡灵！而且如果中低级亡灵一但形成规模在高级以前只有逃命的份！陈林遇袭就是一个例子！而在成为高级亡灵以后则不会出现这种情况，因为伪领域的存在让高级亡灵在中低级亡灵中成为无敌的存在！
因为灵魂之力是最神秘提升起来也是很缓慢，所以这也就成了所有的亡灵生物晋级高级亡灵的一道大坎！只要是灵魂之力足够了那么晋级七阶只是时间的事！而像陈林这样实力没达到高级就已经拥有伪领域的力量根本就没有，主要还是神魂决的原因！
在陈林退出神秘空间发现有敌人后，直接用自己的灵魂使出了伪领域的力量！而这个时候陈林才发现自己的实力也在这次修炼中提示到了六阶高级的水平！看来这次修炼不止是灵魂得到的好处，连实力也有所提升！
小黑也再第一时间发现了陈林的实力，直接从五阶跳跃到了六阶！这种提升速度直接让小黑崇拜的要命，本来觉得自己的提升速度已经很逆天了，没想到主人的速度更变.态！
相对于小黑的惊喜，已经拥有智慧的六阶的亡灵法师和恶灵就要郁闷的多了，本来两个亡灵都是被浓郁的能量给吸引过来的，没想到最后这些能量被眼前的这个怪物都给吸收了，而且还惊动了这个怪物！陈林在这些亡灵眼中就是怪物！直接改变天地见的异象……
“小黑你辛苦了，让我把这两个自以为是的家伙解决了再说……”陈林发现小黑不但实力变强了，而且还收服了手下，就知道小黑这段时间为了保护自己一直被停下来！
于是陈林就将自己的气场伪领域的威压全部压向对面的亡灵，陈林本来像将这几个亡灵直接击杀！可是在陈林使出伪领域后，对方的两个头领直接向陈林臣服了……
陈林一看对方都已经有了智慧，心中一乐直接禁魂咒施展了上去，就这样没有费一点力气直接收服了对方！其实陈林不知道的是对方已经把自己当做八阶以上实力的怪物，用某种能力掩饰住自己的真实实力！因为陈林的展示的伪领域力量绝不是刚刚晋级高级的亡灵能拥有的！
不过要是它们知道了陈林其实，真的只有六阶高级的实力后会怎么看！不过这都已经不重要了，因为它们已经成为陈林忠实的手下了！
陈林在收服这两个智慧亡灵后，发现在它们的灵魂之中不断的有一种奇特的能量通过契约符咒传递给自己！虽然少的可怜不过却真实的存在，而且这种能量极为的纯净进入自己的灵魂后，直接变成了自己的灵魂之力！这一个发现让陈林欣喜若狂！这中能量正是《太平要术》中记载的――信仰之力！
不只是它们两个，在小黑的灵魂契约中也有这中能量传递过来，陈林纳闷为什么以前没又发现呢，可能是自己以前的神魂决修炼的级别太低，灵魂之力还没有现在这么敏锐才没发现！
在确定亡灵能给自己提供信仰之力的时候，直接乐疯了要知道虽然击杀亡灵生物提升的快，但是要是能收服无数个亡灵，那么源源不断的信仰之力却更长久！而且还可以创建自己的势力！于是陈林就将目光看向了刚收服的手下的手下！
可是在收服一个五阶的亡灵后，陈林发现这个亡灵根本没有信仰之力传递过来！这是怎么了，陈林想来想去觉得可能是因为这个亡灵没有智慧！正是因为它没有智慧根本不会信仰陈林，智慧本能的遵从陈林的命令而已！而且拥有的智慧越高信仰之力就会越强！
“要是在人类世界就好了，看来以后还得多收服些智慧的亡灵！”陈林这样想到，心里看是期待人类的世界了！虽然没有智慧的亡灵不能给陈林提供信仰之力，不过眼下这些正是自己报仇的力量！所以陈将所有五阶以上的亡灵都收服了。
在收服周围的亡灵后，陈林手下的势力已经超过了自己之前的队伍！现在自己手里的手下有：六阶的亡灵法师和恶灵各一个；五阶初级的僵尸四名，骷髅战士五名，骷髅法师三名；五阶中级的骷髅弓手七名，恶灵四名！还有五阶巅峰的小黑和他收服的二十几个手下！

看这小黑收服的二十几个手下全是五阶初级，小黑手下的实力和自己的差不多，陈林感到很高兴！小黑现在表现出的智慧已经和人类没什么区别，唯一缺少的就是经验了。
陈林决定要将小黑培养成为一个能统领指挥队伍的将军，帮助自己带领队伍！陈林还发现小黑的所使用的黑色能量，已经控制的更娴熟了，现在只是淡淡的一层围绕在小黑身上，不过给人的感觉却是更危险了！
陈林接下来询问了小黑这一段时间的经历，得知小黑自己对黑色能量又掌握了好几的更高级技巧，攻击和防御能力更强！这让陈林很是羡慕，小黑自己什么也没做，就掌握了这种被叫做毁灭之力的能量！而且即使是现在的陈林还是感觉到毁灭之力很危险，看来这种能量绝对不止如此应该更强大！
看着小黑和自己手下的实力陈林对小黑说道：“看来我们报仇的时候快到了……”

Chapter 13: Chen Lin’s strength, please click and recommend!
After Chen Lin exited the cultivation state, he felt a noise outside the soul space. It seemed like someone... not the undead were fighting! Chen Lin thought that maybe other undead souls were causing trouble while he was practicing!
"Hmph! No matter who it is, those who come to cause trouble must pay a heavy price!" Chen Lin was very angry at being disturbed, and he just wanted to find some undead to try his skills!
The benefits Chen Lin gained from practicing this time are absolutely huge. Now Chen Lin has reached the level of the mortal soul level in the Divine Soul Art! Moreover, Chen Lin's soul power has undergone great changes. Now his mental power can not only be used to explore things, but he can also use his soul power to create an aura. In this aura, Chen Lin feels that he is the god here, and he can use the energy of heaven and earth to suppress the enemy!
Chen Lin didn't know that his current aura was an ability that undead creatures could only comprehend after they advanced to high-level undead! This ability is called the pseudo-domain, and it lays the foundation for future promotion to the holy level! This ability is very powerful. It can not only use the power of heaven and earth to suppress the enemy, but also strengthen itself. Therefore, after advancing to the advanced undead, the strength of the undead will make a big leap!
Before reaching an advanced level, a peak sixth-level undead can only fight against a few intermediate sixth-level undead! And if the mid-to-low-level undead form a large scale, they can only escape before they become advanced! The attack on Chen Lin is an example! This will not happen after becoming a high-level undead, because the existence of the pseudo-realm makes high-level undead invincible among the middle and low-level undead!
Because the power of the soul is the most mysterious and it is very slow to improve, so this has become a big hurdle for all undead creatures to advance to the advanced undead! As long as the soul power is enough, it is only a matter of time to advance to the seventh level! But someone like Chen Lin, whose strength has not yet reached an advanced level and already possesses pseudo-domain power, simply does not have it. The main reason is due to the Divine Soul Art!
After Chen Lin exited the mysterious space and found an enemy, he directly used his soul to use the power of the pseudo-realm! At this time, Chen Lin discovered that his strength had also reached the sixth level of advanced level during this training! It seems that this training not only benefits the soul, but also improves the strength!
Xiao Hei also immediately discovered Chen Lin's strength and jumped directly from the fifth level to the sixth level! This kind of speed of improvement directly makes Xiao Hei admire him to death. He originally thought that his speed of improvement was already incredible, but he didn't expect his master's speed to be even more abnormal!
Compared with Xiao Hei's surprise, the sixth-level necromancers and evil spirits who already possessed wisdom were much more depressed. Originally, the two undead were attracted by the rich energy. Unexpectedly, all the energy was absorbed by the monster in front of him, and even alarmed the monster! Chen Lin is a monster in the eyes of these undead! A vision that directly changes the world's vision...
"Xiao Hei, thank you for your hard work. Let me deal with these two self-righteous guys..." Chen Lin discovered that Xiao Hei had not only become stronger, but also subdued his subordinates. He knew that Xiao Hei had been stopped to protect himself during this period!
So Chen Lin used all the pressure of his aura pseudo-field to attack the undead on the opposite side. Chen Lin originally seemed to kill these undead directly! But after Chen Lin used the pseudo-realm, the two leaders of the opponent directly surrendered to Chen Lin...
When Chen Lin saw that the other party had already gained wisdom, he felt happy and directly cast the soul-forbidden spell, subduing the other party without any effort! In fact, what Chen Lin didn't know was that the other party had regarded him as a monster with level eight or above strength, and used some kind of ability to hide his true strength! Because the pseudo-domain power displayed by Chen Lin is definitely not something that the undead who have just advanced to the advanced level can possess!
But what if they knew that Chen Lin was actually only level six?What will it look like after gaining advanced strength! But this is no longer important, because they have become Chen Lin's loyal subordinates!
After Chen Lin subdued these two intelligent undead, he discovered that a strange energy was constantly being passed to him through the contract talisman in their souls! Although it is pitifully small, it does exist, and after this extremely pure energy enters your soul, it directly becomes the power of your soul! This discovery made Chen Lin ecstatic! This energy is exactly what is recorded in "The Art of Taiping" - the power of faith!
Not only the two of them, this energy was also transmitted in Xiao Hei's soul contract. Chen Lin wondered why he hadn't discovered it before. Maybe it was because his previous level of Divine Soul Art training was too low, and his soul power was not as sharp as it is now, so he didn't notice it!
When I was sure that the undead could provide me with the power of faith, I went crazy with joy. I knew that although killing undead creatures would improve me quickly, if I could subdue countless undead, the continuous power of faith would last longer! And you can also create your own power! So Chen Lin turned his attention to the subordinates who had just conquered him!
However, after subduing a fifth-level undead, Chen Lin discovered that this undead had no power of faith at all! What's going on? Chen Lin thought about it and thought it might be because this undead has no wisdom! It is precisely because it has no wisdom that it will not believe in Chen Lin, and its wisdom instinctively follows Chen Lin's orders! And the higher the wisdom you have, the stronger the power of faith will be!
"It would be great if we were in the human world. It seems that we will have to tame more intelligent undead souls in the future!" Chen Lin thought of this, and he was looking forward to the human world! Although unintelligent undead souls cannot provide Chen Lin with the power of faith, these are the powers for his revenge now! So Chen subdued all the undead above level five.
After subduing the surrounding undead, Chen Lin's forces have surpassed his previous team! Now he has: one sixth-level necromancer and one evil spirit; four fifth-level elementary zombies, five skeleton warriors, and three skeleton mages; seven intermediate fifth-level skeleton archers, and four evil spirits! There is also Xiao Hei, who is at the peak of the fifth level, and the twenty-odd men he has conquered!
Seeing that the twenty or so subordinates that Xiao Hei had conquered were all fifth-level juniors, and the strength of Xiao Hei's subordinates was almost the same as his own, Chen Lin was very happy! Xiao Hei's current wisdom is no different from that of humans. The only thing missing is experience.
Chen Lin decided to train Xiao Hei into a general who can lead the team and help him lead the team! Chen Lin also discovered that the black energy used by Xiao Hei has been controlled more skillfully. Now there is only a faint layer surrounding Xiao Hei, but it feels more dangerous!
Chen Lin then asked Xiao Hei about his experience during this period, and learned that Xiao Hei had mastered several more advanced skills in black energy, and his attack and defense capabilities were stronger! This made Chen Lin very envious. Xiao Hei had mastered this energy called the power of destruction without doing anything! And even now Chen Lin still feels that the power of destruction is dangerous. It seems that this energy is definitely more than this and should be more powerful!
Looking at the strength of Xiao Hei and his men, Chen Lin said to Xiao Hei: "It seems that the time for our revenge is coming soon..."
